# agentcss — full reference (one file)

> Generated from `ai/components.json` + `ai/pitfalls*.json` + `ai/behaviors.json` at version **0.22.0**.
> Do not edit by hand: run `python 05-audit/gen-llms.py` (freshness is gated).
> Short version: `llms.txt`. Machine contract: `ai/*.json`.

Mobile-web CSS component library. Tokens + components + optional behaviour scripts.
No build step, no framework, no third-party runtime dependency. Class names are the API.

## 1 · Query instead of guessing

```bash
npx agentcss ai components --json                     # 39 components, joined with pitfalls
npx agentcss ai components --json --maturity=stable
npx agentcss ai pitfalls --json --component=table
npx agentcss ai tokens --json --set=dark
npx agentcss ai tree --json --set=dark --cat=color
npx agentcss ai validate <file> --schema=components --json
npx agentcss ai check <doc.json> --profile=strict --json
```

Every subcommand accepts `--json`; failures print `{"ok":false,...}` and exit non-zero.

## 3 · Known failure modes (31)

Each one has actually shipped at least once. Full text: `npx agentcss ai pitfalls --json`.

**Component (8)**

- `popover-measure-after-render` — 浮层定位必须在可见状态下测量 · positioning, overlay
- `fixed-element-inventory` — 新增全局悬浮元素前先盘点既有悬浮层 · fixed, z-index
- `single-scroll-container` — 多个滚动容器必然导致行号/表头漂移 · scroll, sticky
- `empty-state-no-decoration` — 空态不要留装饰性元素 · empty, state
- `table-overflow-wrapper` — 表格必须有自己的横向滚动容器 · mobile, overflow, a11y
- `chart-multiline-label` — SVG 的 <text> 不认换行符 · svg, chart
- `line-height-constant-sync` — 用常量算行高时，常量必须与 CSS 同源 · css, sync
- `text-injection-xss` — 动态内容一律走 DOM API，不拼 innerHTML · security, escaping

**Layout (3)**

- `empty-layout-min-height` — 空态时主列矮于侧栏会留下大片空白 · layout, empty
- `self-contained-page-budget` — 自包含页面的体积预算要一开始就定 · performance, mobile, images
- `tokens-not-hardcoded` — 系列化产出先把设计令牌抽成一组常量 · tokens, consistency

**Process (8)**

- `dom-stub-smoke` — 语法检查通过 ≠ 交互能跑 · testing, interaction
- `parallel-edits-verify` — 同一文件的多处修改要串行，并逐条 grep 复核 · tooling, verification
- `stale-server-verify` — 调试前先确认你连的不是旧进程 · debugging, verification
- `field-name-from-definition` — 消费方写的字段名必须对着定义抄 · integration, testing
- `human-semantic-review` — 语义正确性只有人眼能查 · review, semantics
- `evidence-grading` — 措辞强度必须与证据等级匹配 · writing, evidence
- `long-doc-consistency` — 长文里同一结论会被说三遍，还可能自相矛盾 · writing, consistency
- `counterfactual-model-drift` — 反事实推演最容易偷偷换掉前面的模型 · writing, reasoning

**Writing / publishing (12)**

- `demo-must-prove-the-claim` — 演示要证明的是正文那句话，不是「能动就行」 · demo, narrative
- `identifiers-from-source` — 编号、常量、行号、API 名一律回源检索，检索不到就降级表述 · evidence, citation
- `prerender-when-host-strips-scripts` — 目标平台会剥 <script>/<style> 时，架构一开始就得是构建期预渲染 · publishing, prerender
- `two-output-formats` — 「能进任何知识库」要两种载体：自包含 HTML + Markdown · publishing, output
- `source-graded-by-citation` — 来源按「有没有引注」分级，自标缺引注的要明写不作定论 · evidence, sources
- `unverified-source-not-authoritative` — 核不实的来源就降级，别挂权威名头 · evidence, sources
- `md-table-cell-no-pipe` — Markdown 表格单元格里不能出现竖线 · markdown, table
- `declare-what-you-did-not-decode` — 记法不统一时，写「本册不解码」比硬猜值钱 · evidence, scope
- `majority-of-independent-evidence` — 注释与数据冲突时，数独立证据的票，并注明残留 · evidence, conflict
- `plain-language-pass` — 定稿前做一遍「说人话」校对 · prose, editing
- `reproducible-over-descriptive` — 从「有什么」升级到「怎么算」：控制流 + 可手算算例 + 版本固定 · prose, reproducibility
- `counterfactual-worked-example` — 讲「为什么这样选」，就把被否掉的方案算死 · prose, argument

## 4 · Tokens

Light 112 / dark 35. Two exports, same values:

- `ai/tokens.json` — DTCG shape (`$value` / `$type`), feed to design tools
- `ai/tokens.tree.json` — grouped, `value` / `type` without `$`, feed to build tools

Restyle by overriding CSS variables (`--accent`, `--paper`, `--sp-4`, …).
Never rewrite a component selector: it wins on specificity today and breaks silently later.

## 5 · Behaviour cores

| core | global | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| dismissable | `flDismissable` | Esc 关闭 + 点击浮层之外关闭 |
| focus-return | `flFocusReturn` | 记住打开时的焦点，关闭时还回去 |
| roving | `flRoving` | 方向键在一组项里移动 DOM 焦点（roving tabindex） |
| typeahead | `flTypeahead` | 打字母/汉字跳到匹配项（不是过滤） |

These are shared by drawer / tabs / dropdown / overlay / combobox — do not re-implement them.

## 6 · Conventions that are actually gated

- 44×44 px touch targets; `:focus-visible` only, never `outline: 0`.
- States must survive forced-colors: backgrounds are dropped, borders and text are kept.
- Logical properties only (`margin-inline`, `inset-block`) — RTL is not a special case.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` shortens or removes every animation.
- Wide content gets its own `overflow-x` container with `tabindex="0"`.

## 7 · Docs and language

- `README.md` — English quickstart · `README.zh-CN.md` — Chinese detail
- `ai/START-HERE.md` — Chinese navigation for agents
- `demo.html` in each component directory — the ground truth for markup
- Prose docs are Chinese; JSON keys, CLI flags and this file are English.
